headline: Egypt Plans 'Qeema' Certificate to Measure Industrial Local Value
summary: Egypt's Ministry of Industry is developing a 'Qeema' certificate to assess the contribution of industrial products to the national economy and link incentives to performance.
why: Industrial localization policies and certification frameworks aim to incentivize domestic manufacturing content and reduce reliance on imported intermediate goods.

impacts.name: Manufacturing
impacts.why: Performance-linked incentives encourage domestic industrial companies to increase local content sourcing.
